::: {#sol-beats-transitive}

No.
The pair $(\text{rock}, \text{paper})$ is not in $B$;
paper beats rock, not the other way around.
So for $B$, "$a$ beats $b$ and $b$ beats $c$" does not guarantee "$a$ beats $c$".
The properties in this section are rules of this kind,
which a relation may or may not follow.

:::
